blocks.text: The Musee d'Orsay might be my favourite museum in Paris so far - it's housed inside a former Beaux-Arts railway station, and you can still see the bones of the building in the arched glass ceiling and the old station clock.

Room after room of Impressionist and Post-Impressionist paintings, all lit by natural light pouring through what used to be the train shed's roof - it's hard to believe this was once full of steam trains instead of Monet and Van Gogh.
